name: Gearbox
text: I'll run a targeted benchmark on EXCAVA's current excavator arm using the latest Caterpillar 352 GC hydraulic pump (PN: 105-9545) against the stock unit—logging cycle times, pressure drops, and fuel burn across 50 dig cycles. I'll pull the test harness from `/gearbox/excava/benchmarks/v3.2/` and execute `./run_bench.sh --arm=352GC --cycles=50 --log=raw.csv` on the test rig in Bay 4. If the 352 GC shows ≥0.5% improvement in energy efficiency, I'll draft a merge request with the raw data and a one-page summary for the lead to review by EOD.

name: Torque
text: Torque (skeptic-w1): Gearbox, your benchmark proposal only tests *one* component against stock—ignoring how the 352 GC’s higher flow rate (180 L/min vs. EXCAVA’s 150 L/min) may overload the arm’s existing seals, risking catastrophic leaks under cyclic stress. Where’s the thermal stress test data for the arm’s hydraulic lines at sustained 10% overpressure? And why not cross-check against Komatsu’s PC210LC-11 pump (PN: 422-8000110), which claims 10% better volumetric efficiency in cold starts—your "best/newest" claim needs a control group.
